Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying certain venue of action provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to venue of actions by or against counties; andamending RCW 36.01.050.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.01.050 and 2005 c 282 s 42 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All actions against any county may be commenced in the superiorcourt of such county, or in the superior court of either of the twonearest judicial districts. All actions by any county shall becommenced in the superior court of the county in which the defendantresides, or in either of the two judicial districts nearest to thecounty bringing the action. However, where the defendant resides inthe county that is bringing the action, the defendant shall bepermitted to move the action to either of the two nearest judicialdistricts by making the request in accordance with court rules forcivil proceedings. (2) The determination of the nearest judicial districts is measuredby the travel time between county seats using major surface routes, asdetermined by the administrative office of the courts. p. 1 HB 2602 (3) Any provision in any contract with any county that requiresactions arising under the contract to be commenced in the superiorcourt of the county is against public policy and the provision is voidand unenforceable. This subsection shall not be construed to void anycontract provision requiring a dispute arising under the contract to besubmitted to arbitration.
